name: Lakeshire Town Hall
summary: At Lakeshire Town Hall, Magistrate Solomon directs Redridge's affairs from the heart of Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls threaten the lakeside settlement.

sections.title: Seat of Redridge Governance
sections.body:
Lakeshire Town Hall has been refurbished many times over the years. The aging stone building stands prominently in Lakeshire, where it once served as a quiet administrative office. It houses Magistrate Solomon, a kind and dedicated civil leader who keeps order in the eastern reaches of the Kingdom of Stormwind.

Now Stormwind's military is stretched thin and royal aid is scarce. The hall has become an active command center, where desperate appeals for volunteer defenders and mercenaries are handled each day.

sections.title: Under Siege and Overwhelmed
sections.body: Gnoll incursions and advancing Blackrock orcs have driven Magistrate Solomon to desperation. With aid scarce, he readily accepts help from independent adventurers who come through the town hall doors.

faq.q: Who is in charge at Lakeshire Town Hall?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon oversees Lakeshire Town Hall. He is a kind, well-meaning administrator who governs Lakeshire and the surrounding Redridge valley.

faq.q: Why is the town hall seeking so much outside help?
aliases: why are there so many quests here
faq.answer: Lakeshire faces severe and mounting threats from local gnoll packs and hostile Blackrock orc warbands. Stormwind has sent few military reinforcements, so Magistrate Solomon must hire passing adventurers to defend the region.

faq.q: Why does Solomon accept help from travelers?
faq.answer: Gnoll incursions and advancing Blackrock orcs have left Magistrate Solomon desperate. He readily accepts help from independent adventurers who come through the town hall doors.

faq.q: Has Lakeshire Town Hall stood for a long time?
aliases: how old is lakeshire town hall
faq.answer: Yes. The aging building has endured turbulent decades and undergone repairs and refurbishments to keep it functioning as Redridge's civic center.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Lakeshire Town Hall marks Redridge's eastern frontier. This beleaguered outpost holds the line without royal support from Stormwind.
As a human of Stormwind, you see in this refurbished hall the enduring spirit of rural settlements. You also see the frustration regional administrators feel when the capital turns a blind eye.
